I have resolved the issue by updating the MySQL database backend to use `database` and `password` instead of the deprecated `db` and `passwd` keyword arguments:

1. Updated [`DatabaseWrapper.get_connection_params()`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-wcy1cs7j/django/db/backends/mysql/base.py#L194-L206) in [django/db/backends/mysql/base.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-wcy1cs7j/django/db/backends/mysql/base.py) to set `kwargs['database']` and `kwargs['password']`.
2. Updated [`DatabaseClient.settings_to_cmd_args_env()`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-wcy1cs7j/django/db/backends/mysql/client.py#L8-L19) in [django/db/backends/mysql/client.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-wcy1cs7j/django/db/backends/mysql/client.py) to check for `'database'` in `OPTIONS` while retaining fallback support for `'db'`.
